company_name: Tokyo Diamond Tools Mfg. Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Tokyo Diamond Tools specializes in high-precision diamond tools for semiconductor material processing, which are critical for achieving the required surface quality in wafer fabrication.
summary: Tokyo Diamond Tools Mfg. Co., Ltd. manufactures high-precision diamond tools specifically designed for semiconductor processing, including tools for quartz and ceramics used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment. Their metal bond wheels and specialized grinding tools enhance efficiency and precision in wafer finishing processes.
capabilities: Diamond tools for semiconductor material processing
Metal bond wheels for grinding hard and brittle materials
SiC wafer finishing wheels with a 60% wear rate
Diamond pad dressers for polishing processes
